app.name: Digital Madrasa
app.tagline: Quran learning, attendance and fees — for the whole madrasa.

auth.welcomeTitle: Learn, teach and run your madrasa in one place
auth.welcomeBody: Track hifz, take attendance, grade tajweed and collect fees — built for madrasas in Kenya and across East Africa.
auth.registerMadrasaHint: For madrasa owners and head teachers
auth.parentAccountHint: Follow your child's progress and pay fees
auth.signInBody: Sign in to continue where you left off.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code.
auth.resetSent: If that email is registered, a code is on its way.
auth.enterCodeBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 30 minutes.
auth.demoCodeNotice: Demo build: no email is sent. Your code is {{code}}.
auth.newPasswordBody: Pick something you haven't used on this account before.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with a number and a capital letter.
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: You've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
auth.countyHint: Opens a searchable list of all 47 counties
auth.acceptTerms: I agree to the Terms of Service
auth.acceptDataPolicy: I consent to Digital Madrasa processing this data under the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019
auth.registerMadrasaBody: You'll become the owner. You can invite teachers and add students right after.
auth.registerParentBody: After signing up, add your child using the admission number from their madrasa.
auth.demoBody: Explore the app with sample data. No real records are touched.
auth.confirmEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your madrasa.
auth.confirmEmailNote: Your madrasa has been created. You just need to confirm the address before signing in.

validation.phone_invalid: Enter a valid Kenyan number, e.g. 0712 345 678
validation.terms_required: Please accept the terms to continue
validation.amount_invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero
validation.totp_invalid: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator
validation.ayah_range_invalid: The ending ayah must come after the starting ayah
validation.meeting_url_invalid: Use a Google Meet, Teams or Zoom link
validation.score_exceeds_max: Score can't be more than the maximum
validation.reason_required: Write a reason of at least a few words. It goes into the audit log.
validation.confirm_name_required: Type the madrasa's name to confirm.

errors.genericBody: We couldn't complete that. Please try again.
errors.networkBody: We couldn't reach the server, so that change wasn't saved. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password isn't right.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
errors.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
errors.madrasaSuspended: This madrasa has been suspended. Contact your administrator.
errors.cardUnavailable: Card payments aren't available yet. Please pay with M-Pesa.
errors.paymentInProgress: A payment for this bill is already waiting on a phone. Check the phone, or try again in two minutes.
errors.paymentProvider: M-Pesa isn't responding right now. Nothing was charged. Please try again shortly.

empty.noStudentsBody: Add your first student and their admission number is issued automatically.
empty.noClassesBody: Create a class, then assign a teacher and students to it.
empty.noLessonsBody: Lessons your teacher schedules will appear here.
empty.noAssignmentsBody: You're all caught up. New assignments will show up here.
empty.noRecitationsBody: Record your first recitation and get tajweed feedback in seconds.
empty.noInvoicesBody: Fee invoices from the madrasa will appear here.
empty.noMailBody: Fee notices, receipts and school announcements land here.
empty.noMessagesBody: Start a conversation with your child's teacher.
empty.noChildrenBody: Enter the admission number the madrasa gave you and we'll send a request to their teacher.
empty.noRequestsBody: Parent link requests will appear here for you to approve.
empty.noAnnouncementsBody: News from the madrasa will appear here.

student.reciteBody: Read the passage aloud. Stop when you're done.
student.processingBody: This usually takes a few seconds.
student.noFindings: No tajweed issues found. Beautiful recitation.
student.aiDisclaimer: AI feedback assists practice; your teacher's assessment is final.
student.offlineLibraryBody: Download a juz to practise without data.
student.micNeeded: Microphone access is needed to record your recitation. You can turn it on in your device settings.

live.cannotOpenBody: Install the meeting app or open the link in your browser, then try again.
live.unsupportedLink: This link is not from a supported meeting provider.
live.manageBody: Paste a Google Meet, Teams or Zoom link. Students see a Join button 15 minutes before the lesson starts.

teacher.addStudentBody: The admission number is issued automatically — you don't need to type one.
teacher.admissionNoBody: Share this with the parent so they can link to {{name}}.
teacher.bulkImportBody: Upload a CSV and review before committing.
teacher.searchStudents: Search by name or admission number
teacher.overrideBody: Your score replaces the AI score on the report card.
teacher.subject: Subject
teacher.qrAttendanceBody: Students scan this code as they arrive. It refreshes every 30 seconds.
teacher.inviteNoEmail: No email was sent. Ask them to open Digital Madrasa, choose "Forgot password" and enter this address to set their own.

parent.addChildBody: Enter the admission number the madrasa gave you. Their teacher will approve the request.
parent.requestSentBody: We've asked {{madrasa}} to confirm. You'll be notified once it's approved.
parent.linkFailed: We couldn't verify that admission number
parent.linkFailedBody: Check the number with the madrasa and try again.
parent.mpesaPromptBody: Enter your M-Pesa PIN on the prompt we just sent to {{phone}}.
parent.paymentFailedBody: No money has left your account. You can try again.
parent.notificationPrefsBody: Choose how you hear from the madrasa.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartRequired: Restart the app to finish switching direction

billing.mpesaHint: Pay from your phone with an STK prompt
billing.securityNote: Your card details are encrypted and sent straight to our payment provider. We never store your card number.
billing.trialTitle: {{count}} day left in your free trial
billing.trialTitle_other: {{count}} days left in your free trial
billing.trialBody: After that it is {{price}} a month to keep enrolling students and collecting fees.
billing.pastDueBody: Your trial has ended. Pay {{price}} to continue.
billing.graceBody: You can still run the madrasa for a few more days. Pay now to avoid interruption.
billing.restrictedBody: Students keep learning and nothing has been deleted. Pay to restore adding students and issuing invoices.
billing.cancelledBody: Reactivate any time. Your data is untouched.
billing.graceEnds: Admin features lock on {{date}}, {{count}} days after the missed payment.
billing.learningNeverBlocked: Students never lose access to their lessons, recitations or progress — whatever happens with billing.
billing.oneMonthOfAccess: One month of full access for your whole madrasa.
billing.mpesaPhoneHint: The number that will receive the payment prompt
billing.stkSent: Enter your M-Pesa PIN to approve {{price}}.
billing.cardProcessing: This takes a few seconds. Do not close the app.
billing.paymentSuccessBody: Your madrasa is paid up for the next month. Thank you.
billing.paymentFailedBody: The payment did not go through. No money has left your account.
billing.noPayments: No payments yet. Your first charge happens when the trial ends.
billing.ownerOnly: Only the madrasa owner can change the subscription.
billing.cardHostedNote: You will enter your card on Paystack’s secure payment page. Digital Madrasa never sees or stores your card number.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.subtitle: Answers from your own records

emptyBody.student: Ask how you are progressing or what to revise next.
emptyBody.teacher: Ask about class performance or which students need support.
emptyBody.parent: Ask how your child is doing, or what would help them improve.
emptyBody.admin: Ask about activity across the platform.

ai.clearBody: The messages will be removed. Nothing is saved to your device.
ai.chooseChildBody: Choose which child you are asking about first.
ai.disclaimer: AI guidance assists study; your teacher’s assessment is final.

scan.title: Scan attendance
scan.intro: Point your camera at the code your teacher is showing.
scan.frameHint: Hold the code inside the square
scan.permissionBody: Digital Madrasa needs your camera to read the attendance code. Nothing is recorded except that you were present.
scan.permissionDenied: Camera permission was declined. Turn it on in Settings, then come back.
scan.expired: That code has expired. Ask your teacher for a fresh one.
scan.wrongClass: That code is for a different class.
scan.unreadable: That code could not be read. Try again.

invoicing.setupBody: Choose the fee, then say exactly who it is for.
invoicing.wholeMadrasaWarning: This bills every enrolled student in the madrasa. Check the count on the next screen before confirming.
invoicing.reviewBody: Check the target and the total. Nothing is charged until you confirm.
invoicing.nothingToIssue: Everyone in this target already has an invoice for this fee, so there is nothing to issue.
invoicing.allAlreadyBilled: No invoices were raised: {{count}} student already had one for this fee.
invoicing.allAlreadyBilled_other: No invoices were raised: {{count}} students already had one for this fee.

learning.wholeSurahNote: The whole surah will be recorded as memorised.
learning.noCompletedJuz: No juz is fully memorised yet.
learning.quranNotComplete: The whole Quran is not yet recorded as memorised.
learning.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this certificate? It will verify as withdrawn.
learning.shareText: {{title}} — awarded to {{name}} by {{madrasa}}. Verify with code {{code}} in the Digital Madrasa app.
learning.verifyBody: Enter the 10-character code printed on the certificate.
learning.recordInstead: This assignment is answered by recording a recitation.
learning.lockedMarked: This work has been marked and can no longer be changed.

library.removeConfirm: Remove Juz {{juz}} from this phone? You can download it again later.
library.errorOffline: Could not download. Check your connection and try again.
library.errorCorrupt: The download was incomplete, so it was not saved. Please try again.
library.notDownloaded: This juz is not on your phone
library.notDownloadedBody: Go back to the library and download it first.
library.source: Quran text: Uthmani script from The Noble Qur'an Encyclopedia (quranenc.com), via quran-json (CC BY 4.0).
library.phoneOnlyTitle: The offline library is in the phone app
library.phoneOnlyBody: Downloaded juz are saved on your phone so you can read without data. Open Digital Madrasa on your phone to use it.

admin.webOnlyTitle: Open the admin console on a computer
admin.webOnlyBody: The platform admin console runs in a web browser, where there is room to read before acting on a whole school. This app is for madrasas and families.
admin.overviewSubtitle: Every school at a glance. Counts only: no pupil records are shown here.
admin.madrasasSubtitle: Search schools and review their standing.
admin.feesCollectedCaption: Paid to madrasas through the app
admin.deliveryStalled: {{n}} notifications have waited over 10 minutes. Check the dispatcher.
admin.notFoundBody: It may have been purged. Go back to the list.
admin.noActions: This madrasa has been deleted. Only its audit record remains.

explain.suspend: Suspension takes effect at once and can be undone. Staff, parents and pupils lose access until the madrasa is reinstated; nothing is deleted.
explain.schedule_deletion: The madrasa is closed and its records are kept for 30 days, then purged. It can be reinstated until then. The owner is notified.
explain.reinstate: Restores normal access for everyone in this madrasa.
explain.purge: Permanently deletes this madrasa's records. This cannot be undone. Type the madrasa's name exactly to confirm.

admin.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log, with your name and the time.
admin.confirmMismatch: That does not match the madrasa's name exactly.
admin.auditSubtitle: Every recorded action across the platform, newest first. The log cannot be edited.
admin.noAuditBody: Actions will appear here as they happen.

aiFeedback.consentBodyParent: When on, your child’s recitation recordings are sent to Google’s Gemini AI for automatic tajweed feedback. No name is sent, and the teacher’s review is always final. You can turn this off at any time.
aiFeedback.consentBodyStaff: Turn on only with the parent’s written consent. Recordings are sent to Google’s Gemini AI for automatic feedback; no name is sent.
aiFeedback.notConsented: AI feedback is off for this student, so the recording was not sent for automatic feedback. The teacher will review it.
aiFeedback.unavailable: Automatic feedback was not available this time. The teacher will review this recitation.
aiFeedback.notHeard: The passage could not be heard in this recording. Recite clearly, close to the phone, and try again. The teacher will also review it.

sanad.title: My chain of transmission
sanad.subtitle: Your sanad, printed on every ijazah you award
sanad.fieldLabel: One teacher per line, starting with the sheikh who gave you ijazah
sanad.hint: Each line is the teacher of the line above.
sanad.needed: An ijazah carries your chain of transmission. Record it first.

plan.title: Today’s hifz plan
plan.sabqiHint: Recent revision — the last two weeks
plan.manzilHint: Old revision — all of it every {{days}} days

heatmap.title: Mistake map
heatmap.subtitle: Where pupils slip most in their recitation
heatmap.tapRule: Tap a rule to show only its mistakes.
heatmap.filtered: Showing {{rule}} only. Tap it again to show all.
heatmap.emptyBody: Once recitations are assessed, the ayahs pupils find hardest appear here.
